explanation: The value is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and is only above 0 at GO when the agent chooses a2 and the previous trial was rewarded after a common transition. It is about 10 early in the episode (roughly trials 5-20), about 8 on the first rewarded trial after a loss or around trials 35-48, and 0 when the choice is a1, the previous trial was unrewarded, the previous reward followed a rare transition, or the trial is late in the episode (after about trial 50).
